name: blur-in
title: Blur In
description: A single element is revealed with blur, opacity and a directional offset, settling in place: a premium entrance for a card, image or composed scene.
useWhen: Revealing a card, image or composed scene with a premium blur entrance.
Staggering several elements into view by revealing each one at a different time.
avoidWhen: You are animating a text-only line: use a text reveal such as soft-blur-in or staggered-fade-up.
You need a full-opacity slide with no blur: use a translation only.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Blur
variables.description: Starting blur radius in design pixels.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far the card travels into place, in design pixels. 0 reveals in place.

variables.label: Direction
variables.description: Direction the card travels into place: up starts below, down starts above, left starts to the right, right starts to the left.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.
